title: When the Colony Falls
author: Tamsin Winterbourne
blurb: Yara Nystrom, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the fleet's truce expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
